Author: BlueWaveXIV
Name: AutoBuy
Description: Private Market Board helper that searches configured gear keywords and buys listings at or below a configurable gil cap.
Punchline: Buy underpriced gear sets from the Market Board.
Changelog: Bargain trips now close Market Board windows after each world shopping run, return to Ul'dah Aetheryte Plaza, then request next-world travel or Back to Ravana. Storage-full completion follows the same close-window and plaza-return sequence.
